headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over alleged trade secret theft
body: OpenAI accuses Apple of "coercing and threatening" suppliers that work with both companies, in a countersuit filed Friday in a California court, the Financial Times reports. The company also alleges that Apple encourages employees to store corporate data on personal devices. The countersuit follows Apple's lawsuit from the summer, which accused several former employees of leaking confidential information to OpenAI.
note: OpenAI is preparing its own devices to rival Apple, and the suppliers both companies work with are now part of the fight.

evidence.text: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
OpenAI is suing Apple for trade secret theft and unfair business practices.
The ChatGPT maker filed the lawsuit Friday in a California court, the Financial Times reports
OpenAI accuses Apple of "coercing and threatening" suppliers that work with both companies and of using its market power to stifle competition.
The company also alleges that Apple encourages employees to store corporate data on personal devices, then turns that practice against staff who want to leave.
The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer , which accused several former employees of leaking confidential information to OpenAI.
The AI company had previously closed its $6.4 billion acquisition of former Apple chief designer Jony Ive's studio "io" and is preparing its own devices to rival Apple .
